title: 游戏机制与系统异常
description: 多个游戏机制表现异常或设计不合理，如自动驾驶效率低、NPC情绪系统导致船员不工作、睡眠时间不一致、温度异常、电池无故取出、角色卡住、移动缓慢。
evidence: Autopilot for interplanetary travel cheats, uses too much fuel and still smacks you into planets sometimes
Your crew won't work? Well, if you look for answers online you get debug commands as a standard answer
sometimes I have to sleep 18 hours to get rested but other times just a few hours

evidence_items.quote: Batteries will be taken out of the chargers for no reason
evidence_items.description: 电池无故从充电器中被取出
evidence_items.quote_zh: 电池会无缘无故地从充电器中被取出来

evidence_items.quote: Autopilot for interplanetary travel cheats, uses too much fuel and still smacks you into planets sometimes
evidence_items.description: 行星际自动驾驶作弊、耗油过多且有时撞上行星
evidence_items.quote_zh: 行星际旅行的自动驾驶会作弊，消耗过多燃料，有时还会把你撞向行星

evidence_items.quote: *sometimes* re-pressurising a room ends up with it being barely a few Kelvin hot
evidence_items.description: 重新加压房间后温度异常，有时只有几开尔文
evidence_items.quote_zh: *有时候*给房间重新加压后，它最终会热到只有几开尔文

evidence_items.quote: sometimes I have to sleep 18 hours to get rested but other times just a few hours
evidence_items.description: 睡眠时间不一致，有时需睡18小时
evidence_items.quote_zh: 有时我得睡18个小时才能休息好，但其他时候只需几个小时

evidence_items.quote: Your crew won't work? Well, if you look for answers online you get debug commands as a standard answer
evidence_items.description: NPC情绪系统导致船员不工作，需要在线查找调试命令
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你的船员不肯干活？好吧，如果你上网找答案，得到的标准回答就是调试命令

evidence_items.quote: Once, I got stuck in the pod on the side of nav. console after exiting it.
evidence_items.description: 从导航控制台退出后卡在舱内
evidence_items.quote_zh: 有一次，我从导航控制台旁边的舱体出来后被困在了里面。
